tagline: Spends health like currency for cards, actions and damage — then takes it back

featuredCards.title: Forged by suffering
featuredCards.caption: One damage, two cards. The exchange rate that the rest of the deck is priced against.

featuredCards.title: I have you now
featuredCards.caption: A 5 that sells him an extra action for a point of health. Tempo, bought with the health bar.

featuredCards.title: Dark lord of the sith
featuredCards.caption: Pay up to five of his own health and every point goes onto the value. There is no ceiling he respects.

featuredCards.title: More machine than man
featuredCards.caption: Heals two, and while it stays out every winning attack heals another. The bill gets paid off between turns.
